regions.label: Left subiculum (aimed at Left POR)
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Left subiculum, not Left POR. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.
